newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan National Bank distributes '96 cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Jordan National Bank distributes '96 cash dividend.

text.p: Jordan National Bank approved on Saturday, before a formal merger with Business Bank, a 180 fils cash dividend per share to existing shareholders.
The bank's shareholders approved at its annual meeting the board's request to distribute a 180 fils cash dividend against 140 fils cash dividend last year.
The bank did not announce any 1996 profits.
The bank merged with the smaller Business Bank on Saturday in the first link-up of its kind in local banking. The new bank will keep the name Jordan National Bank.

Prior to Saturday's merger, Jordan National Bank had capital of 16 million dinars and Business Bank had six million. The combined capital has been boosted to 42 million dinars by a transfer from shareholders equity and reserves, the bank said.
